passage:
The city published open data about bus times, parks, public toilets, and air quality. Anyone could use the information to build apps or study problems.
A student group used the data to make a map of bus stops without shade. They found that many were in neighborhoods with more older residents.
Their report helped the city decide where to add shelters first.
Open data sounded boring at first. Then students saw that it could support fairness.
Information locked away helps only a few people. Information shared responsibly can help communities ask better questions and demand better answers.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which title is best for the complete passage that includes “The city published open data about bus times, parks, public toilets, and air quality.”?

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The Train Announcement」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Public Shade Project」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The Open Data Project: The city published open data about bus times, parks, public toilets, and air quality.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The Forgotten Public Toilet」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

questions.stem: What happens next in this passage after “They found that many were in neighborhoods with more older residents.”?
options: Their report helped the city decide where to add shelters first.
The school agreed to add one fountain first and review the need for another.
A city wanted to add colorful lights to a historic bridge to attract tourists.
The city office finally agreed to paint a new crossing and add a warning light.
